notes.title: Content Update
notes.content:
Added Fury Mode that can be unlocked by reaching the 7th section or by unlocking all 6 character perks. Fury Mode allows the player to skip straight to the hardest parts of the game for the added challenge and for the chance to unlock a fairly tough achievement called Fury.

Patch also fixes a small issue with cloud corrupting saves in a way that stops perks from being unlocked. Alongside this, extra room variants have been added.

Finally, some text throughout the game has been changed to be more easily understandable for none native English speakers. For example, instead of calling the player's ability warp, its now called teleport.

notes.title: Large Content Update V1.4
notes.content:
Large update for NEO NEO has just gone live! it adds in-game scoreboards, entirely new levels, traps, and achievements but also dramatically changes existing levels and perks.

- New levels.
- In-game scoreboards
- New floor trap.
- Balance changes to the saw blades.
- Infinite warp has been completely changed to be more interesting.
- Random Storm and Infinite Red have also changed to be far more effective.
- Moving saw blades put the player into slow-motion when very close.
- 3 new achievements have been added.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32904587/c5fb97c5d58fb67f26ed7fdab6d6584c43f4dfec.png[/img]

notes.title: Large Update Inbound July
notes.content:
A large update will arrive early July, The update will change up the balance of most perks, add entirely new levels with new traps, replace rooms that don't work 'looking at you saw blades' and Full in-game leader board.

Controller support is also on the list but is 100% dependent on how well it works with the game. Other things of note are new perks and enemys but they on the bottom of the list for now.

notes.title: Update V1.3 Flash Options and Guides
notes.content:
Main features are the ability to turn off most flashing, and the guide/help section in the main menu to help new and old players.

- Added a effects option that can be turned off to disable a large number of flashing effects.
- Balanced Shotgun trooper weapon to fire slower projectiles.
- Slightly lowered the enemy troopers ability to see the player.
- Redesigned the main menu to have a guide section what teaches the player how to play the game.
- The guide section uses videos to display features and systems to a basic degree, so that our none English speaking friends can understand the game better.
- Saw Blades have had there colliders fixed so that they do not interfere with warping in a incorrect way anymore.
- Players shield displays if its destroyed or not far better now, with a improved graphic and sound effect.
- Some slight changes to exit sections to remove anti climatic loses.
	
As always. Thanks everyone for your support, none of this would be possible otherwise!

notes.title: Update V1.2 Steam Scoreboards
notes.content:
Global and friends only scoreboards has been soft launched for Neo Neo. Currently does not show ingame but inside the steam browsers alongside steam achievements. Will be updated in the future to have UI within the game to show global and friend scores.

Thanks everyone for your support over the past few days, really been amazing.

notes.title: Update V1.15
notes.content:
-Fixed the zoom setting in the options menu, it now correctly updates.
-Added extra large mouse cursors that are much easier to see. 

Side note, the extra large mouse cursors will hopefully be updated again in the future to a system that allows for much better control over exact size.

notes.title: Update 1.1 released
notes.content:
-Fixed problems with achievements unlocking too early.
-Balanced Infinite Redz perk so that it does not spawn random units at the start.
-Decreased needed kills and time for Infinite Redz perk achievement.
-Balanced Random Storm perk, to spawn less high up enemies.
-Fixed Text not displaying correctly.
-I suspect I'm missing things but overall, the game is hopefully better.

If anyone is having trouble please post your problems into the Neo Neo discussion page. I will try my best to fix what ever problem you maybe having.

Never the less, thanks to everyone's support on this slightly bumpy launch, it really means a lot!
